note: Scenario playbooks. Each one is a chain of agent + tool steps with a quality gate. Same JSON can be exposed as an MCP tool, rendered as a guide, or packaged as a sellable pack.

workflows.title: UGC-style product ad (30-60s vertical)

steps.do: Pull 5 viewer pain points and 3 competing hooks from the Brain / web search. Output: ranked hook list.
Write 3 scripts (hook in first 2s, one benefit per beat, one CTA). Output: scripts with shot list.
Generate b-roll / product stills and the on-screen text cards matching the shot list.
Voice-over (TTS) and a 20s music bed; match the cut points.
steps.tool: voice/TTS, music bot, FL Studio MCP

steps.do: Assemble: cut to beats, burn captions, export 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9.
Run the compliance gate below before anything ships.

qualityGate: Hook lands in under 2 seconds with sound off (captions carry it)
Every claim has a source or is removed
One call to action, on screen for the last 3 seconds
Readable on a phone at arm's length
compliance: Disclose AI-generated people/voices where the platform requires it
No invented testimonials, reviews, results, or 'real customer' framing
No real person's likeness or voice without written permission
Mark paid/sponsored content per platform rules

workflows.title: Game design pitch + 45s trailer
inputs: core loop (what you do every 30 seconds)

steps.do: Stress-test the premise: who plays it, why it's different, what the first 5 minutes feel like. Output: one-page design brief.
Capture 3-5 clean gameplay clips (60fps, no UI clutter) and a 10s idle loop.
Key art + logo lockup + 3 feature cards in one consistent palette.
Original 45s music cue that rises with the trailer beats; export stems.
Store page copy: tagline, 3 bullets, long description, patch-note tone for updates.
Cut trailer: hook, loop, feature beats, title card with release window.

qualityGate: A stranger can say what you do in the game after 15 seconds
Only real footage is labelled gameplay
Audio ducks under voice/captions, no clipping
compliance: No fake review quotes or fake player counts

workflows.title: Long video to captioned vertical shorts
inputs: video file or URL you have rights to

steps.do: Transcribe locally (Whisper) with word timestamps.
Score segments for hook strength, self-contained story, payoff. Output: ranked timestamps.
Cut, reframe to 9:16 (face-aware crop), burn captions in the chosen style.
Title, hook line and hashtags per short.
Rights + quote-accuracy check, then queue for scheduling.

qualityGate: Each short stands alone with no missing context
Captions match the audio word for word
First frame is not black or a title card
compliance: Only clip content you own or have permission to use
Keep speaker quotes accurate and in context

workflows.title: Cinematic token/brand site in a day (the $ASIMOV playbook)
inputs: subject + one-line pitch (confirmed back to the user)
token config (CA, socials, pair) or 'none yet'

steps.do: Write MASTER-PROMPT.md: audience, sections, voice, truth rules, CTA. Confirm the subject.
Research and verify every fact, credit and lore item; produce the Sources list.
Theme tokens + fonts, mascot character sheet, hero art direction. Screenshot every round.
Scaffold from kits/cinematic-site (no build step), wire sections, 3D hero, intro, swivels, motion.js.
Playwright pass: desktop + mobile per section, zero overflow, zero page errors; fix what the screenshots show.
Compliance gate below, then private repo → Render Blueprint.

qualityGate: Subject confirmed in one line before building
Every section screenshotted at 1360 and 390 wide, no horizontal overflow
WebGL pieces have fallbacks; reduced motion respected
Every claim sourced or hedged; every artwork credited and linked
compliance: No rehosted copyrighted covers, paintings or film frames: homage + credit + link
Affiliate disclosure once a tag is set
No invented holders, volume, partnerships or testimonials

workflows.title: Original animated mini movie / trailer (HyperFrames, 1080p, 2–3 min)
inputs: licensed excerpts (optional, with the user's OK)

steps.do: Script as a time/beat/visual/sound table with logline, through-line and sources.
Fact-check every beat; hedge or cut.
Composition from kits/hyperframes-film: 3D world shots (CUT table), 2D chapter painters, INS remap for inserted chapters.
Score (numpy synth + splice), supers, snapshot contact sheets at every beat; fix framing.
Render in the background (~60 frames/min), verify duration and audio, compress to under 30 MB, deliver.

qualityGate: audio in sync (no dropped samples at splices)
end card: credits, fiction labels, not-affiliated
compliance: Original animation only; licensed excerpts git-ignored and credited
No real person's likeness without permission
